jobs.title: Clinical Care Coordinator at 5 Star Medical Practice | TMS & Interventional Psych Concierge
jobs.description:
**Modern Minds Health is hiring!**

We are a physician\-led outpatient psychiatry practice in Sacramento specializing in advanced treatments for depression and other psychiatric conditions, including **Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS), Spravato®/esketamine, medication management, and accelerated TMS protocols**.

We are looking for an intelligent, motivated, highly organized individual to join our team as a **Clinical Care Coordinator – TMS \& Interventional Psychiatry**.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent college graduate interested in **medicine, PA school, psychology, neuroscience, nursing, or another healthcare profession** who wants meaningful clinical experience before pursuing further training.

Unlike a traditional medical assistant or front\-desk position, this role combines **direct patient care, TMS treatment delivery, insurance authorization, care coordination, and exposure to the day\-to\-day practice of interventional psychiatry.**

**Time Requirements**

* Part\-time position (future opportunities for full\-time employment may arise)
* Must be available to work Sundays regularly

***Job Summary***

**The Role**

You will work closely with our clinical and administrative teams to help patients move from referral and insurance authorization through active treatment.

A major part of the position involves becoming trained as a **TMS technician**, working directly with patients receiving treatment for depression and other psychiatric conditions.

You will also help coordinate the administrative work necessary to get patients into treatment—including insurance authorizations, collecting clinical records, communicating with patients and referring offices, and tracking patients through the treatment process.

The ideal candidate is **bright, dependable, personable, detail\-oriented, and genuinely interested in healthcare.** No prior TMS experience is required. We will provide training.

**Responsibilities: TMS \& Patient Care**

* Train to administer TMS treatments under established clinical protocols and clinician supervision
* Prepare patients and treatment equipment for TMS sessions
* Accurately document treatments and patient\-reported symptoms
* Monitor patients during treatment and communicate clinical concerns to the appropriate provider
* Develop professional, supportive relationships with patients completing multi\-week treatment courses
* Assist with standardized symptom assessments and treatment outcome tracking
* Help maintain a safe, clean, organized, and comfortable treatment environment
* Cross\-train in other interventional psychiatry programs as appropriate

**Insurance Authorization \& Care Coordination**

* Coordinate insurance authorization for TMS and other treatment programs
* Collect medication histories, treatment records, and other documentation required for authorization
* Track authorization status and follow up with insurers, patients, pharmacies, and referring offices
* Help identify missing information that could delay treatment
* Maintain organized tracking of patients moving from referral through authorization and treatment
* Communicate clearly with patients regarding next steps
* Coordinate records and communication with outside psychiatrists, therapists, primary care clinicians, and referral partners

**Clinic Operations**

* Assist with scheduling and patient communication
* Monitor EMR messages, tasks, and treatment\-related follow\-up
* Help maintain treatment supplies and inventory
* Support the clinical team with day\-to\-day patient flow
* Pitch in where needed in a growing private practice

**Who We Think Will Thrive Here**

You may be a particularly strong fit if you:

* Have a strong academic background and enjoy learning
* Are comfortable interacting with patients experiencing depression and other psychiatric conditions
* Are meticulous about details and follow\-through
* Can manage multiple patients and administrative processes without losing track of tasks
* Communicate professionally by phone, email, and in person
* Are comfortable learning new technology and medical equipment
* Take ownership when something needs to get done
* Want more responsibility than a typical entry\-level medical office position

Prior healthcare experience is helpful but **not required**. We care more about intelligence, reliability, judgment, communication skills, and the ability to learn quickly.

**What You’ll Learn**

This position provides hands\-on exposure to an area of psychiatry that most pre\-health students rarely encounter.

Depending on your responsibilities and training, you may gain experience with:

* Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS)
* Treatment\-resistant depression
* Spravato®/esketamine treatment
* Accelerated TMS protocols
* Psychiatric symptom measurement and outcome tracking
* Clinical documentation and electronic medical records
* Insurance authorization and medical\-necessity requirements
* Coordination between psychiatrists, therapists, primary care clinicians, pharmacies, and insurers
* The operations of a growing specialty medical practice

You will work alongside psychiatrists, advanced practice clinicians, and an experienced clinical team while developing a practical understanding of how modern psychiatric treatment is delivered.

**Why Modern Minds Health?**

We are building a different kind of psychiatric practice: clinically rigorous, measurement\-driven, patient\-centered, and focused on treatments that can meaningfully change patients’ lives.

Because we are a growing private practice, strong team members can take on meaningful responsibility quickly. We value people who are curious, capable, kind, and willing to learn.

jobs.title: Nursing Program Coordinator - TAVR*
jobs.description:
**The Job**
-----------

  

  

**Arrowhead Regional Medical Center (ARMC)** is recruiting for a **Nursing Program Coordinator** who will participate in quality improvement activities and support the ongoing development and effectiveness of the **TAVR** program**.** The Nursing Program Coordinator will coordinate and oversee the **Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR)** program, including patient care coordination, education, quality metrics, data, and registries for procedures. Responsibilities include coordinating patient referrals, authorizations, and procedures; providing education and support to patients and families; and facilitating communication among patients, families, physicians, clinical staff, and external partners. ***Official Title:*** *Nursing Program Coordinator. For more detailed information, refer to the****Nursing Program Coordinator****job description.* **ARROWHEAD REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER**  

Located on a beautiful 70\-acre campus in Colton, California (50 miles east of Los Angeles), **Arrowhead Regional Medical Center (ARMC)** is a state\-of\-the\-art, public/nonprofit, 456\-bed, university affiliated teaching hospital licensed by the State of California Department of Public Health and accredited by The Joint Commission. The hospital houses a regional burn center serving four counties (San Bernardino, Riverside, Mono and Inyo), a comprehensive stroke center, level I trauma center and a freestanding in\-patient behavioral health center. Additionally, ARMC operates five community\-based, primary care clinics and over 40 specialty care outpatient services. ARMC is the primary teaching hospital for the adjacently located California University of Science and Medicine (CUSM), the Inland Empire's newest medical school. ***To learn more about Arrowhead Regional Medical Center****,* ***please visit:******www.arrowheadregional.org*** **EXCELLENT BENEFITS**
